description: A unified AI assistant combining women's health guidance (SheCare AI) and women's safety/emergency support (SheSecure AI), built on AWS PartyRock.
problem_statements_addressed: SheCare AI - Women's health & wellness assistant
SheSecure AI - Women's safety & emergency assistant

team.organized_by: Aspire For Her, in collaboration with Logitech

app_flow.description: User selects life stage first; this drives personalization across both health and safety widgets (the core innovation of this app).

widgets.label: Tell us about yourself
widgets.placeholder: e.g., I'm a teenager / I'm pregnant / I'm postpartum / I'm a working professional / I'm a student
widgets.purpose: Captures life stage to personalize downstream widgets

widgets.label: Describe your symptoms or health concern
widgets.placeholder: e.g., cramps, missed period, dizziness, fatigue

widgets.label: Health Guidance
widgets.prompt: You are a compassionate women's health assistant. The user's life stage is: {{user_profile_input}}. Based on the symptoms described: {{symptom_input}}, classify urgency as: Self-care / See a doctor soon / Seek emergency care. Explain why in 2-3 simple sentences in {{language_choice}}. Never diagnose; always recommend professional consultation for anything serious.

widgets.label: Enter your last period start date (DD-MM-YYYY)
Cycle & Fertility Insights
widgets.prompt: Based on the last period start date: {{cycle_tracker_input}}, estimate the next expected period date, fertile window, and give 2 practical self-care tips for this phase. Keep tone supportive and factual. Respond in {{language_choice}}.

widgets.label: Type a health myth you've heard
widgets.placeholder: e.g., You shouldn't exercise during periods

widgets.label: Myth vs Fact
widgets.prompt: The user shared this women's health myth: {{myth_input}}. Clearly state whether it is TRUE or FALSE, then explain the medical fact in 2-3 simple sentences. Be respectful of cultural context, non-judgmental in tone. Respond in {{language_choice}}.

widgets.label: Personalized Diet & Exercise Tips
widgets.prompt: Based on life stage: {{user_profile_input}} and any symptoms mentioned: {{symptom_input}}, suggest a simple daily diet and light exercise routine suited to this stage. Keep it practical and achievable, in {{language_choice}}.

widgets.label: Hospital & Gynecologist Guidance
widgets.prompt: The user is located in {{hospital_city_input}} and has this concern: {{symptom_input}}. Suggest the type of medical facility/specialist they should look for (e.g., gynecologist, maternity hospital, general physician) and general guidance on what to check when choosing one nearby. Do not fabricate specific hospital names or addresses; instead advise how to search reliably (Google Maps, government health portal, helpline).

widgets.label: Describe your situation
widgets.placeholder: e.g., walking alone at night, using a cab, at a new workplace

widgets.label: Personalized Safety Plan
widgets.prompt: The user's life stage is {{user_profile_input}} and their situation is: {{safety_scenario_input}}. Provide a tailored safety checklist of 4-6 practical, actionable tips for this specific scenario and life stage. Respond in {{language_choice}}.

widgets.label: Your current location
widgets.placeholder: e.g., near XYZ bus stand, Ameerpet

widgets.label: Briefly describe the emergency
widgets.placeholder: e.g., being followed, feel unsafe, need immediate help

widgets.label: SOS Message (ready to send)
widgets.prompt: Generate a short, clear emergency SOS text message using this info: Location: {{sos_location_input}}, Situation: {{sos_situation_input}}. The message should be under 40 words, urgent but calm, include location, and ask for immediate help. Output only the message, ready to copy and send.

widgets.label: Legal Rights & Helpline Info
widgets.prompt: The user selected issue type: {{legal_helpline_input}}. Provide: (1) relevant Indian legal provisions (BNS/IPC sections, or applicable act) in simple language, (2) 2-3 official helpline numbers (e.g., Women Helpline 181, Police 100, Cyber Crime 1930), (3) one practical next step. Keep it factual and concise, in {{language_choice}}.

widgets.label: Paste a message or conversation you're unsure about
Red Flag Analysis
widgets.prompt: Analyze the following message for manipulative, controlling, or predatory language patterns: {{red_flag_input}}. List any red flags found in bullet points with brief explanations, in a supportive, non-alarmist tone. If none found, reassure the user. Respond in {{language_choice}}.

innovation_highlight.description: The user_profile_input (life stage: teenager, pregnant, postpartum, working professional, student) feeds into BOTH the health widgets AND the safety widgets, so advice in both pillars is automatically tailored to the same life stage. This is what unifies the two problem statements into a single coherent product rather than two separate apps.

future_scope: Real GPS integration for live location sharing with emergency contacts
Integration with real hospital/doctor directory APIs
Offline SMS-based SOS fallback for low-connectivity areas
